purpose: test-only source-owned callback Grant certificate plus separate companion owner/request-consumer evidence

callback.annotation_policy: contravariant concrete signal permission at the resolved callback formal/port; permission does not add signal to actual inflow

annotation_permission.rule: permission is source-owned by the resolved annotation/formal/port and current invocation; retain the resolved effect identity, not a display-name match

callback_entry.rule: read entry and receipt from their owning stores; link the entry to the same invocation and resolved formal

parameter_name_read.rule: the source Name read is the actual direct parameter-name Apply callee; no identifier spelling substitutes for the receipt/site join

callback_use.rule: use joins to the exact entry, Name receipt, source view, Apply occurrence and result receipt

result_execution.rule: execution is minted by the result view/receipt constructor and is live in the owning execution table

request_event.rule: request/event is an actual emitted contribution with the callback execution as origin; permission and request are separate records

local_grant.rule: the reported true result comes from the owning local_grant/callback_grant constructors and the authenticated observation; preserve each exact owner/view/formal/receipt/event/effect join

catch_consumer.rule: the selected handler and arm consume this actual request; result value alone is not an identity witness

lean_projection.rule: derive projected constructors from source-owned records; do not supply a target predicate, History, or Grant result as an unexplained premise

complete_frame_projection.rule: saved template suffix and retained outer stack are separate; every mandatory owner/receiver/handler boundary is present and endpoint-connected

surviving_write_evidence.rule: record the actual write contribution that remains after the signal handler; do not infer whole-support deletion or treat callback permission as unconditional removal

mutations.rule: absent targets are reported as inapplicable and cannot be counted as successful rejection mutations

authority: test-only observations and validators plus a bounded Lean source projection; no compiler behavior, source fixtures, expected output, dependencies, parent quantifiers, or production authority change
